title: Restore automatic ReMCP package updates independently of the installed Node.js environment.
changes: Enable automatic updates of the first-party @remcp/remcp and @remcp/runtime npm packages by default on Linux, macOS and Windows, while preserving an explicit owner opt-out.
Reload the managed agent after an effective remcp auto-update on/off change, deferring Linux restarts so remote commands complete.
Keep existing exact server-advertised client/runtime release-pair and isolated npm-prefix safeguards; never update Node.js, npm or unrelated global packages.
Do not label historical CLI paths that disappeared after a Node.js change as multiple live installations.
Expand regression coverage and clarify in public documentation how ReMCP package updates differ from Node.js upgrades.
